summary: Tested the engineer report fields (Description of Work Completed, Further Work Required, Further Parts Required, Start/End time) and the customer sign-off across the Service Desk engineer job, the MOD/BFPO job, MOD PPM, the Service Desk case drawer and the Maintenance Calendar visit detail, plus the Service Desk Equipment 'All sites' option and the asset-list PDF. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass. Checked: report normalisation (blank parts dropped, qty>=1, UTC ISO times), 400 when end < start, sign-off still required, GET case returns engineer_report and signoff with image_data, the ENGINEER REPORT block appears in the service-report PDF, the MOD job-sheet and the PPM certificate (and the old layout is used when there is no report), PPM schedule visits[] return engineer_report and signoff, customer-equipment site_id=all returns site_name, and the asset-list PDF is landscape, grouped by site, shows the last service visit, returns 404 for another org and 401/403 without auth. Frontend: every flow works end to end (UI-filed reports were confirmed in the DB). Times prefill from timers, part suggestions come from the catalogue, the time error shows, completing with 'customer not available' + reason works, and the locked view, drawer, PPM detail and printable report all show the data. Found 1 layout bug (part row), several minor UX issues, and some incomplete parity on MOD screens.

minor.issue: end_time == start_time is accepted although the message says 'End time must be after the start time' (it uses a strict < check). A zero-minute report passes.

_site_equipment includes equipment whose site_id is missing or None in every single-site view, but not site_id == ''. In iso-demo-org 3 machines with site_id '' only appear under All sites. Unassigned handling is inconsistent.
The signature is inserted into svc_signatures before the PDF build and the status update. A failure afterwards leaves an orphan signature, and a retry inserts another one.

ui_bugs.issue: Layout bug on desktop and mobile: the qty input gets `w-full w-20` (inputCls already contains w-full, and w-full wins), so the quantity box stretches across the row and the part name input collapses to about 20px wide. Typed or selected part names cannot be read. Fix: don't use inputCls's w-full on qty (e.g. `w-20 shrink-0`) and add min-w-0 to the name input.

EngineerReportView is rendered without a signoff prop, so inside the report card it shows 'No customer signature captured.' even when a signature or an unavailable reason exists. The card below then shows 'Customer unable to sign — …', which contradicts it. Pass signoff={job.signature} (and drop the duplicate card) or hide the SignoffBlock here.
The 'All sites · N machines' count adds up the sites' equipment_count, which leaves out unassigned equipment. iso-demo-org shows 'All sites · 22 machines' but lists 29.

integration_issues.issue: If the first selected machine is Unassigned (no site_id), the intake modal opens with '— Select site —' and 'No equipment on this site', and the selected machine is lost. A mixed-site selection silently logs everything against the first machine's site, with no warning.

onPartSearch is not passed, so there are no parts-catalogue suggestions on the MOD screens. After completion, neither the MOD job recap (jobdetail-completed-recap) nor the completed PPM service shows the engineer report (no EngineerReportView); only the summary or certificate link is shown.

issues: A closed (completed) visit shows the stage badge 'ALLOCATED' above the engineer report. This comes from the existing receipt-stage logic, but it reads oddly for a completed visit.

action_items: Fix the EngineerReportFields part row layout (qty w-full/w-20 conflict collapses the part name input)
Pass the signoff into EngineerReportView on the locked Complete tab (it currently says 'No customer signature captured.' when one exists)
Include unassigned equipment in the 'All sites · N machines' count
Handle Log case from All sites when the first selected machine has no site, and warn when the selected machines span several sites
Optional: add onPartSearch to the MOD JobDetail/PPM report fields, and show EngineerReportView on completed MOD jobs and PPM services
Optional: reject end_time == start_time, or reword the message
critical_code_review_comments: EngineerJobDetailV2.js is 4370 lines (existing). The new CompleteTab report logic adds to it, so consider extracting CompleteTab.
DeskEquipment printList: the blob URL from URL.createObjectURL is never revoked.
The PPMServiceDetail certificate link is a plain <a href> to an authenticated endpoint (existing). It only works if cookie auth is present.
clean_report compares ISO strings. This is safe because both are normalised to UTC isoformat, but comparing datetimes would be more robust.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all flows work; 1 HIGH layout bug, 1 MEDIUM display bug, minor UX gaps)

test_credentials: The provided MOD staff login lee.somers@bfpo.pulsefitness.com / pulse123 returns 'Invalid credentials' (that user does not exist). Used admin@pulsefitness.com (counts as BFPO 'staff' via mod operations) for the MOD APIs and engineer.gib@bfpo.pulsefitness.test / BfpoEng123! (portal=mod, token set in localStorage, /bfpo) for the MOD UI. owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! for the Service Desk Equipment and Maintenance Calendar.
seed_data_creation: All test data was seeded directly in Mongo with TEST_ ids (svc_cases, svc_time_entries, svc_parts, ppm_schedules, bfpo_ppm_services, equipment, svc_signatures) and deleted by id afterwards. That includes the auto-filed PPM certificate documents (documents.linked_to.id), the invoice draft auto-created by the svc Complete flow, and svc_case_events. Audit-log and op-update ledger rows from the UI completions remain (immutable ledgers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The regression file /app/backend/tests/test_engineer_report_asset_list.py seeds its own data via pymongo and cleans up. Run it with: pytest tests/test_engineer_report_asset_list.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. For the engineer job UI: seed an svc_case in admin org d19de469 assigned to admin 1fedcc01 with safety_signoff_waived and an svc_time_entries row, then open /svc/engineer/jobs/<id>?tab=complete. The Complete flow auto-creates an invoice draft (svc_engineer_invoices), so clean it up. The Maintenance Calendar search box (ppm-search-input) opens PpmScheduleDetail. The MOD PWA cookie banner blocks the bottom nav; click 'Decline' first.
